content.latin: ℣. Dómine, lábia + mea apéries.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, + open thou my lips.

segments.t: Dómine, lábia + mea apéries.

content.latin: ℟. Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
content.english: ℟. And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

segments.t: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

content.latin: Ant. Regem Confessórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem Confessórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
content.english: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

content.latin: Ant. Regem Confessórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem Confessórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
content.english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. O come, let us worship.

segments.t: Ant.
Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius (genuflectitur) veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
content.english: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. (genuflect) Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

segments.t: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius
(genuflectitur)
veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.

content.latin: Ant. Regem Confessórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem Confessórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
content.english: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. O come, let us worship.

segments.t: Ant.
Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
content.english: Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

content.latin: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
content.english: This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph

content.latin: Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
content.english: Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness

content.latin: Hac die lætus méruit suprémos
content.english: On this feast day year by year receiveth

content.latin: Laudis honóres.
content.english: Merited honors.

content.latin: Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
content.english: Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,

content.latin: Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
content.english: Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.

content.latin: Donec humános animávit auræ
content.english: While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,

content.latin: Spíritus artus.
content.english: Quickened his being.

content.latin: Cuius ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
content.english: Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,

content.latin: Ægra quæ passim iacuére membra,
content.english: Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,

content.latin: Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
content.english: Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,

content.latin: Restituúntur.
content.english: At his petition.

content.latin: Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
content.english: Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,

content.latin: Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
content.english: Chanting his praises with devout affection,

content.latin: Ut piis eius précibus iuvémur
content.english: That in his merits we may have a portion,

content.latin: Omne per ævum.
content.english: Now and forever.

content.latin: Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
content.english: His be the glory, power and salvation,

content.latin: Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
content.english: Who over all things reigneth in the highest,

content.latin: Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
content.english: Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,

content.latin: Trinus et unus.
content.english: Onely and Trinal.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ad Nocturnum
content.english: At the Nocturn

segments.t: Ad Nocturnum

content.latin: Ant. Expúgna, Dómine, * impugnántes me.
content.english: Ant. Overthrow, O Lord, * them that fight against me.

segments.t: Ant.
Expúgna, Dómine, * impugnántes me.
Psalmus 34(1-10)

content.latin: 34:1 Iúdica, Dómine, nocéntes me, * expúgna impugnántes me.
content.english: 34:1 Judge thou, O Lord, them that wrong me: * overthrow them that fight against me.

segments.t: Iúdica, Dómine, nocéntes me, * expúgna impugnántes me.

content.latin: 34:2 Apprehénde arma et scutum: * et exsúrge in adiutórium mihi.
content.english: 34:2 Take hold of arms and shield: * and rise up to help me.

segments.t: Apprehénde arma et scutum: * et exsúrge in adiutórium mihi.

content.latin: 34:3 Effúnde frámeam, et conclúde advérsus eos, qui persequúntur me: * dic ánimæ meæ: Salus tua ego sum.
content.english: 34:3 Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me: * say to my soul: I am thy salvation.

segments.t: Effúnde frámeam, et conclúde advérsus eos, qui persequúntur me: * dic ánimæ meæ: Salus tua ego sum.

content.latin: 34:4 Confundántur et revereántur, * quæréntes ánimam meam.
content.english: 34:4 Let them be confounded and ashamed * that seek after my soul.

segments.t: Confundántur et revereántur, * quæréntes ánimam meam.

content.latin: 34:4 Avertántur retrórsum, et confundántur * cogitántes mihi mala.
content.english: 34:4 Let them be turned back and be confounded * that devise against me.

segments.t: Avertántur retrórsum, et confundántur * cogitántes mihi mala.

content.latin: 34:5 Fiant tamquam pulvis ante fáciem venti: * et Ángelus Dómini coárctans eos.
content.english: 34:5 Let them become as dust before the wind: * and let the Angel of the Lord straiten them.

segments.t: Fiant tamquam pulvis ante fáciem venti: * et Ángelus Dómini coárctans eos.

content.latin: 34:6 Fiat via illórum ténebræ et lúbricum: * et Ángelus Dómini pérsequens eos.
content.english: 34:6 Let their way become dark and slippery; * and let the Angel of the Lord pursue them.

segments.t: Fiat via illórum ténebræ et lúbricum: * et Ángelus Dómini pérsequens eos.

content.latin: 34:7 Quóniam gratis abscondérunt mihi intéritum láquei sui: * supervácue exprobravérunt ánimam meam.
content.english: 34:7 For without cause they have hidden their net for me unto destruction: * without cause they have upbraided my soul.

segments.t: Quóniam gratis abscondérunt mihi intéritum láquei sui: * supervácue exprobravérunt ánimam meam.

content.latin: 34:8 Véniat illi láqueus, quem ignórat: et cáptio, quam abscóndit, apprehéndat eum: * et in láqueum cadat in ipsum.
content.english: 34:8 Let the snare which he knoweth not come upon him: and let the net which he hath hidden catch him: * and into that very snare let them fall.

segments.t: Véniat illi láqueus, quem ignórat: et cáptio, quam abscóndit, apprehéndat eum: * et in láqueum cadat in ipsum.

content.latin: 34:9 Ánima autem mea exsultábit in Dómino: * et delectábitur super salutári suo.
content.english: 34:9 But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; * and shall be delighted in his salvation.

segments.t: Ánima autem mea exsultábit in Dómino: * et delectábitur super salutári suo.

content.latin: 34:10 Ómnia ossa mea dicent: * Dómine, quis símilis tibi?
content.english: 34:10 All my bones shall say: * Lord, who is like to thee?

segments.t: Ómnia ossa mea dicent: * Dómine, quis símilis tibi?

content.latin: 34:10 Erípiens ínopem de manu fortiórum eius: * egénum et páuperem a diripiéntibus eum.
content.english: 34:10 Who deliverest the poor from the hand of them that are stronger than he; * the needy and the poor from them that strip him.

segments.t: Erípiens ínopem de manu fortiórum eius: * egénum et páuperem a diripiéntibus eum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: Ant. Overthrow, O Lord, them that fight against me.

segments.t: Ant.
Expúgna, Dómine, impugnántes me.

content.latin: Ant. Restítue ánimam meam * a malefáctis eórum, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Rescue, O Lord, * my soul from their malice.

segments.t: Ant.
Restítue ánimam meam * a malefáctis eórum, Dómine.
Psalmus 34(11-17)

content.latin: 34:11 Surgéntes testes iníqui, * quæ ignorábam interrogábant me.
content.english: 34:11 Unjust witnesses rising up * have asked me things I knew not.

segments.t: Surgéntes testes iníqui, * quæ ignorábam interrogábant me.

content.latin: 34:12 Retribuébant mihi mala pro bonis: * sterilitátem ánimæ meæ.
content.english: 34:12 They repaid me evil for good: * to the depriving me of my soul.

segments.t: Retribuébant mihi mala pro bonis: * sterilitátem ánimæ meæ.

content.latin: 34:13 Ego autem cum mihi molésti essent, * induébar cilício.
content.english: 34:13 But as for me, when they were troublesome to me, * I was clothed with haircloth.

segments.t: Ego autem cum mihi molésti essent, * induébar cilício.

content.latin: 34:13 Humiliábam in ieiúnio ánimam meam: * et orátio mea in sinu meo convertétur.
content.english: 34:13 I humbled my soul with fasting; * and my prayer shall be turned into my bosom.

segments.t: Humiliábam in ieiúnio ánimam meam: * et orátio mea in sinu meo convertétur.

content.latin: 34:14 Quasi próximum, et quasi fratrem nostrum, sic complacébam: * quasi lugens et contristátus, sic humiliábar.
content.english: 34:14 As a neighbour and as an own brother, so did I please: * as one mourning and sorrowful so was I humbled.

segments.t: Quasi próximum, et quasi fratrem nostrum, sic complacébam: * quasi lugens et contristátus, sic humiliábar.

content.latin: 34:15 Et advérsum me lætáti sunt, et convenérunt: * congregáta sunt super me flagélla, et ignorávi.
content.english: 34:15 But they rejoiced against me, and came together: * scourges were gathered together upon me, and I knew not.

segments.t: Et advérsum me lætáti sunt, et convenérunt: * congregáta sunt super me flagélla, et ignorávi.

content.latin: 34:16 Dissipáti sunt, nec compúncti, tentavérunt me, subsannavérunt me subsannatióne: * frenduérunt super me déntibus suis.
content.english: 34:16 They were separated, and repented not: they tempted me, they scoffed at me with scorn: * they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

segments.t: Dissipáti sunt, nec compúncti, tentavérunt me, subsannavérunt me subsannatióne: * frenduérunt super me déntibus suis.

content.latin: 34:17 Dómine, quando respícies? * restítue ánimam meam a malignitáte eórum, a leónibus únicam meam.
content.english: 34:17 Lord, when wilt thou look upon me? * rescue thou my soul from their malice: my only one from the lions.

segments.t: Dómine, quando respícies? * restítue ánimam meam a malignitáte eórum, a leónibus únicam meam.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Restítue ánimam meam a malefáctis eórum, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Rescue, O Lord, my soul from their malice.

segments.t: Ant.
Restítue ánimam meam a malefáctis eórum, Dómine.

content.latin: Ant. Exsúrge, Dómine, * et inténde iudício meo.
content.english: Ant. Arise, O Lord, * and be attentive to my judgment.

segments.t: Ant.
Exsúrge, Dómine, * et inténde iudício meo.
Psalmus 34(18-28)

content.latin: 34:18 Confitébor tibi in ecclésia magna, * in pópulo gravi laudábo te.
content.english: 34:18 I will give thanks to thee in a great church; * I will praise thee in a strong people.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi in ecclésia magna, * in pópulo gravi laudábo te.

content.latin: 34:19 Non supergáudeant mihi qui adversántur mihi iníque: * qui odérunt me gratis et ánnuunt óculis.
content.english: 34:19 Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: * who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.

segments.t: Non supergáudeant mihi qui adversántur mihi iníque: * qui odérunt me gratis et ánnuunt óculis.

content.latin: 34:20 Quóniam mihi quidem pacífice loquebántur: * et in iracúndia terræ loquéntes, dolos cogitábant.
content.english: 34:20 For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; * and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.

segments.t: Quóniam mihi quidem pacífice loquebántur: * et in iracúndia terræ loquéntes, dolos cogitábant.

content.latin: 34:21 Et dilatavérunt super me os suum: * dixérunt: Euge, euge, vidérunt óculi nostri.
content.english: 34:21 And they opened their mouth wide against me; * they said: Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.

segments.t: Et dilatavérunt super me os suum: * dixérunt: Euge, euge, vidérunt óculi nostri.

content.latin: 34:22 Vidísti, Dómine, ne síleas: * Dómine, ne discédas a me.
content.english: 34:22 Thou hast seen, O Lord, be not thou silent: * O Lord, depart not from me.

segments.t: Vidísti, Dómine, ne síleas: * Dómine, ne discédas a me.

content.latin: 34:23 Exsúrge et inténde iudício meo: * Deus meus, et Dóminus meus in causam meam.
content.english: 34:23 Arise, and be attentive to my judgment: * to my cause, my God, and my Lord.

segments.t: Exsúrge et inténde iudício meo: * Deus meus, et Dóminus meus in causam meam.

content.latin: 34:24 Iúdica me secúndum iustítiam tuam, Dómine, Deus meus, * et non supergáudeant mihi.
content.english: 34:24 Judge me, O Lord my God according to thy justice, * and let them not rejoice over me.

segments.t: Iúdica me secúndum iustítiam tuam, Dómine, Deus meus, * et non supergáudeant mihi.

content.latin: 34:25 Non dicant in córdibus suis: Euge, euge, ánimæ nostræ: * nec dicant: Devorávimus eum.
content.english: 34:25 Let them not say in their hearts: It is well, it is well, to our mind: * neither let them say: We have swallowed him up.

segments.t: Non dicant in córdibus suis: Euge, euge, ánimæ nostræ: * nec dicant: Devorávimus eum.

content.latin: 34:26 Erubéscant et revereántur simul, * qui gratulántur malis meis.
content.english: 34:26 Let them blush: and be ashamed together, * who rejoice at my evils.

segments.t: Erubéscant et revereántur simul, * qui gratulántur malis meis.

content.latin: 34:26 Induántur confusióne et reveréntia * qui magna loquúntur super me.
content.english: 34:26 Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, * who speak great things against me.

segments.t: Induántur confusióne et reveréntia * qui magna loquúntur super me.

content.latin: 34:27 Exsúltent et læténtur qui volunt iustítiam meam: * et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus qui volunt pacem servi eius.
content.english: 34:27 Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice, * and let them say always: The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of his servant.

segments.t: Exsúltent et læténtur qui volunt iustítiam meam: * et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus qui volunt pacem servi eius.

content.latin: 34:28 Et lingua mea meditábitur iustítiam tuam, * tota die laudem tuam.
content.english: 34:28 And my tongue shall meditate thy justice, * thy praise all the day long.

segments.t: Et lingua mea meditábitur iustítiam tuam, * tota die laudem tuam.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Exsúrge, Dómine, et inténde iudício meo.
content.english: Ant. Arise, O Lord, and be attentive to my judgment.

segments.t: Ant.
Exsúrge, Dómine, et inténde iudício meo.

content.latin: Ant. Noli æmulári * in eo qui prosperátur et facit iniquitátem.
content.english: Ant. Envy not * the man who prospereth in his way; the man who doth unjust things.

segments.t: Ant.
Noli æmulári * in eo qui prosperátur et facit iniquitátem.
Psalmus 36(1-15)

content.latin: 36:1 Noli æmulári in malignántibus: * neque zeláveris faciéntes iniquitátem.
content.english: 36:1 Be not emulous of evildoers; * nor envy them that work iniquity.

segments.t: Noli æmulári in malignántibus: * neque zeláveris faciéntes iniquitátem.

content.latin: 36:2 Quóniam tamquam fænum velóciter aréscent: * et quemádmodum ólera herbárum cito décident.
content.english: 36:2 For they shall shortly wither away as grass, * and as the green herbs shall quickly fall.

segments.t: Quóniam tamquam fænum velóciter aréscent: * et quemádmodum ólera herbárum cito décident.

content.latin: 36:3 Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem: * et inhábita terram, et pascéris in divítiis eius.
content.english: 36:3 Trust in the Lord, and do good, * and dwell in the land, and thou shalt be fed with its riches.

segments.t: Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem: * et inhábita terram, et pascéris in divítiis eius.

content.latin: 36:4 Delectáre in Dómino: * et dabit tibi petitiónes cordis tui.
content.english: 36:4 Delight in the Lord, * and he will give thee the requests of thy heart.

segments.t: Delectáre in Dómino: * et dabit tibi petitiónes cordis tui.

content.latin: 36:5 Revéla Dómino viam tuam, et spera in eo: * et ipse fáciet.
content.english: 36:5 Commit thy way to the Lord, and trust in him, * and he will do it.

segments.t: Revéla Dómino viam tuam, et spera in eo: * et ipse fáciet.

content.latin: 36:6 Et edúcet quasi lumen iustítiam tuam: et iudícium tuum tamquam merídiem: * súbditus esto Dómino, et ora eum.
content.english: 36:6 And he will bring forth thy justice as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday: * be subject to the Lord and pray to him.

segments.t: Et edúcet quasi lumen iustítiam tuam: et iudícium tuum tamquam merídiem: * súbditus esto Dómino, et ora eum.

content.latin: 36:7 Noli æmulári in eo, qui prosperátur in via sua: * in hómine faciénte iniustítias.
content.english: 36:7 Envy not the man who prospereth in his way; * the man who doth unjust things.

segments.t: Noli æmulári in eo, qui prosperátur in via sua: * in hómine faciénte iniustítias.

content.latin: 36:8 Désine ab ira, et derelínque furórem: * noli æmulári ut malignéris.
content.english: 36:8 Cease from anger, and leave rage; * have no emulation to do evil.

segments.t: Désine ab ira, et derelínque furórem: * noli æmulári ut malignéris.

content.latin: 36:9 Quóniam qui malignántur, exterminabúntur: * sustinéntes autem Dóminum, ipsi hereditábunt terram.
content.english: 36:9 For the evildoers shall be cut off: * but they that wait upon the Lord shall inherit the land.

segments.t: Quóniam qui malignántur, exterminabúntur: * sustinéntes autem Dóminum, ipsi hereditábunt terram.

content.latin: 36:10 Et adhuc pusíllum, et non erit peccátor: * et quæres locum eius et non invénies.
content.english: 36:10 For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: * and thou shalt seek his place, and shalt not find it.

segments.t: Et adhuc pusíllum, et non erit peccátor: * et quæres locum eius et non invénies.

content.latin: 36:11 Mansuéti autem hereditábunt terram: * et delectabúntur in multitúdine pacis.
content.english: 36:11 But the meek shall inherit the land, * and shall delight in abundance of peace.

segments.t: Mansuéti autem hereditábunt terram: * et delectabúntur in multitúdine pacis.

content.latin: 36:12 Observábit peccátor iustum: * et stridébit super eum déntibus suis.
content.english: 36:12 The sinner shall watch the just man: * and shall gnash upon him with his teeth.

segments.t: Observábit peccátor iustum: * et stridébit super eum déntibus suis.

content.latin: 36:13 Dóminus autem irridébit eum: * quóniam próspicit quod véniet dies eius.
content.english: 36:13 But the Lord shall laugh at him: * for he foreseeth that his day shall come.

segments.t: Dóminus autem irridébit eum: * quóniam próspicit quod véniet dies eius.

content.latin: 36:14 Gládium evaginavérunt peccatóres: * intendérunt arcum suum,
content.english: 36:14 The wicked have drawn out the sword: * they have bent their bow.

segments.t: Gládium evaginavérunt peccatóres: * intendérunt arcum suum,

content.latin: 36:14 Ut deíciant páuperem et ínopem: * ut trucídent rectos corde.
content.english: 36:14 To cast down the poor and needy, * to kill the upright of heart.

segments.t: Ut deíciant páuperem et ínopem: * ut trucídent rectos corde.

content.latin: 36:15 Gládius eórum intret in corda ipsórum: * et arcus eórum confringátur.
content.english: 36:15 Let their sword enter into their own hearts, * and let their bow be broken.

segments.t: Gládius eórum intret in corda ipsórum: * et arcus eórum confringátur.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Noli æmulári in eo qui prosperátur et facit iniquitátem.
content.english: Ant. Envy not the man who prospereth in his way; the man who doth unjust things.

segments.t: Ant.
Noli æmulári in eo qui prosperátur et facit iniquitátem.

content.latin: Ant. Brácchia peccatórum * conteréntur, confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.
content.english: Ant. The arms of the wicked * shall be broken in pieces; but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

segments.t: Ant.
Brácchia peccatórum * conteréntur, confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.
Psalmus 36(16-29)

content.latin: 36:16 Mélius est módicum iusto, * super divítias peccatórum multas.
content.english: 36:16 Better is a little to the just, * than the great riches of the wicked.

segments.t: Mélius est módicum iusto, * super divítias peccatórum multas.

content.latin: 36:17 Quóniam brácchia peccatórum conteréntur: * confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.
content.english: 36:17 For the arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces; * but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

segments.t: Quóniam brácchia peccatórum conteréntur: * confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.

content.latin: 36:18 Novit Dóminus dies immaculatórum: * et heréditas eórum in ætérnum erit.
content.english: 36:18 The Lord knoweth the days of the undefiled; * and their inheritance shall be for ever.

segments.t: Novit Dóminus dies immaculatórum: * et heréditas eórum in ætérnum erit.

content.latin: 36:19 Non confundéntur in témpore malo, et in diébus famis saturabúntur: * quia peccatóres períbunt.
content.english: 36:19 They shall not be confounded in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be filled, * because the wicked shall perish.

segments.t: Non confundéntur in témpore malo, et in diébus famis saturabúntur: * quia peccatóres períbunt.

content.latin: 36:20 Inimíci vero Dómini mox ut honorificáti fúerint et exaltáti: * deficiéntes, quemádmodum fumus defícient.
content.english: 36:20 And the enemies of the Lord, presently after they shall be honoured and exalted, * shall come to nothing and vanish like smoke.

segments.t: Inimíci vero Dómini mox ut honorificáti fúerint et exaltáti: * deficiéntes, quemádmodum fumus defícient.

content.latin: 36:21 Mutuábitur peccátor, et non solvet: * iustus autem miserétur et tríbuet.
content.english: 36:21 The sinner shall borrow, and not pay again; * but the just sheweth mercy and shall give.

segments.t: Mutuábitur peccátor, et non solvet: * iustus autem miserétur et tríbuet.

content.latin: 36:22 Quia benedicéntes ei hereditábunt terram: * maledicéntes autem ei disperíbunt.
content.english: 36:22 For such as bless him shall inherit the land: * but such as curse him shall perish.

segments.t: Quia benedicéntes ei hereditábunt terram: * maledicéntes autem ei disperíbunt.

content.latin: 36:23 Apud Dóminum gressus hóminis dirigéntur: * et viam eius volet.
content.english: 36:23 With the Lord shall the steps of a man be directed, * and he shall like well his way.

segments.t: Apud Dóminum gressus hóminis dirigéntur: * et viam eius volet.

content.latin: 36:24 Cum cecíderit non collidétur: * quia Dóminus suppónit manum suam.
content.english: 36:24 When he shall fall he shall not be bruised, * for the Lord putteth his hand under him.

segments.t: Cum cecíderit non collidétur: * quia Dóminus suppónit manum suam.

content.latin: 36:25 Iúnior fui, étenim sénui: * et non vidi iustum derelíctum, nec semen eius quærens panem.
content.english: 36:25 I have been young, and now am old; * and I have not seen the just forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

segments.t: Iúnior fui, étenim sénui: * et non vidi iustum derelíctum, nec semen eius quærens panem.

content.latin: 36:26 Tota die miserétur et cómmodat: * et semen illíus in benedictióne erit.
content.english: 36:26 He sheweth mercy, and lendeth all the day long; * and his seed shall be in blessing.

segments.t: Tota die miserétur et cómmodat: * et semen illíus in benedictióne erit.

content.latin: 36:27 Declína a malo, et fac bonum: * et inhábita in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 36:27 Decline from evil and do good, * and dwell for ever and ever.

segments.t: Declína a malo, et fac bonum: * et inhábita in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 36:28 Quia Dóminus amat iudícium, et non derelínquet sanctos suos: * in ætérnum conservabúntur.
content.english: 36:28 For the Lord loveth judgment, and will not forsake his saints: * they shall be preserved for ever.

segments.t: Quia Dóminus amat iudícium, et non derelínquet sanctos suos: * in ætérnum conservabúntur.

content.latin: 36:28 Iniústi puniéntur: * et semen impiórum períbit.
content.english: 36:28 The unjust shall be punished, * and the seed of the wicked shall perish.

segments.t: Iniústi puniéntur: * et semen impiórum períbit.

content.latin: 36:29 Iusti autem hereditábunt terram: * et inhabitábunt in sǽculum sǽculi super eam.
content.english: 36:29 But the just shall inherit the land, * and shall dwell therein for evermore.

segments.t: Iusti autem hereditábunt terram: * et inhabitábunt in sǽculum sǽculi super eam.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Brácchia peccatórum conteréntur, confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.
content.english: Ant. The arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces; but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

segments.t: Ant.
Brácchia peccatórum conteréntur, confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.

content.latin: Ant. Custódi innocéntiam * et vide æquitátem.
content.english: Ant. Keep innocence * and behold justice.

segments.t: Ant.
Custódi innocéntiam * et vide æquitátem.
Psalmus 36(30-40)

content.latin: 36:30 Os iusti meditábitur sapiéntiam, * et lingua eius loquétur iudícium.
content.english: 36:30 The mouth of the just shall meditate wisdom: * and his tongue shall speak judgment.

segments.t: Os iusti meditábitur sapiéntiam, * et lingua eius loquétur iudícium.

content.latin: 36:31 Lex Dei eius in corde ipsíus, * et non supplantabúntur gressus eius.
content.english: 36:31 The law of his God is in his heart, * and his steps shall not be supplanted.

segments.t: Lex Dei eius in corde ipsíus, * et non supplantabúntur gressus eius.

content.latin: 36:32 Consíderat peccátor iustum: * et quærit mortificáre eum.
content.english: 36:32 The wicked watcheth the just man, * and seeketh to put him to death.

segments.t: Consíderat peccátor iustum: * et quærit mortificáre eum.

content.latin: 36:33 Dóminus autem non derelínquet eum in mánibus eius: * nec damnábit eum, cum iudicábitur illi.
content.english: 36:33 But the Lord will not leave him in his hands; * nor condemn him when he shall be judged.

segments.t: Dóminus autem non derelínquet eum in mánibus eius: * nec damnábit eum, cum iudicábitur illi.

content.latin: 36:34 Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam eius: et exaltábit te ut hereditáte cápias terram: * cum períerint peccatóres vidébis.
content.english: 36:34 Expect the Lord and keep his way: and he will exalt thee to inherit the land: * when the sinners shall perish thou shalt see.

segments.t: Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam eius: et exaltábit te ut hereditáte cápias terram: * cum períerint peccatóres vidébis.

content.latin: 36:35 Vidi ímpium superexaltátum, * et elevátum sicut cedros Líbani.
content.english: 36:35 I have seen the wicked highly exalted, * and lifted up like the cedars of Libanus.

segments.t: Vidi ímpium superexaltátum, * et elevátum sicut cedros Líbani.

content.latin: 36:36 Et transívi, et ecce non erat: * et quæsívi eum, et non est invéntus locus eius.
content.english: 36:36 And I passed by, and lo, he was not: * and I sought him and his place was not found.

segments.t: Et transívi, et ecce non erat: * et quæsívi eum, et non est invéntus locus eius.

content.latin: 36:37 Custódi innocéntiam, et vide æquitátem: * quóniam sunt relíquiæ hómini pacífico.
content.english: 36:37 Keep innocence, and behold justice: * for there are remnants for the peaceable man.

segments.t: Custódi innocéntiam, et vide æquitátem: * quóniam sunt relíquiæ hómini pacífico.

content.latin: 36:38 Iniústi autem disperíbunt simul: * relíquiæ impiórum interíbunt.
content.english: 36:38 But the unjust shall be destroyed together: * the remnants of the wicked shall perish.

segments.t: Iniústi autem disperíbunt simul: * relíquiæ impiórum interíbunt.

content.latin: 36:39 Salus autem iustórum a Dómino: * et protéctor eórum in témpore tribulatiónis.
content.english: 36:39 But the salvation of the just is from the Lord, * and he is their protector in the time of trouble.

segments.t: Salus autem iustórum a Dómino: * et protéctor eórum in témpore tribulatiónis.

content.latin: 36:40 Et adiuvábit eos Dóminus et liberábit eos: * et éruet eos a peccatóribus, et salvábit eos: quia speravérunt in eo.
content.english: 36:40 And the Lord will help them and deliver them: * and he will rescue them from the wicked, and save them, because they have hoped in him.

segments.t: Et adiuvábit eos Dóminus et liberábit eos: * et éruet eos a peccatóribus, et salvábit eos: quia speravérunt in eo.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Custódi innocéntiam et vide æquitátem.
content.english: Ant. Keep innocence and behold justice.

segments.t: Ant.
Custódi innocéntiam et vide æquitátem.

content.latin: Ant. Ne in ira tua * corrípias me, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. O Lord, * do not chastise me in thy wrath.

segments.t: Ant.
Ne in ira tua * corrípias me, Dómine.
Psalmus 37(2-11)

content.latin: 37:2 Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
content.english: 37:2 Rebuke me not, O Lord, in thy indignation; * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

segments.t: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.

content.latin: 37:3 Quóniam sagíttæ tuæ infíxæ sunt mihi: * et confirmásti super me manum tuam.
content.english: 37:3 For thy arrows are fastened in me: * and thy hand hath been strong upon me.

segments.t: Quóniam sagíttæ tuæ infíxæ sunt mihi: * et confirmásti super me manum tuam.

content.latin: 37:4 Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie iræ tuæ: * non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.
content.english: 37:4 There is no health in my flesh, because of thy wrath: * there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.

segments.t: Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie iræ tuæ: * non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.

content.latin: 37:5 Quóniam iniquitátes meæ supergréssæ sunt caput meum: * et sicut onus grave gravátæ sunt super me.
content.english: 37:5 For my iniquities are gone over my head: * and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.

segments.t: Quóniam iniquitátes meæ supergréssæ sunt caput meum: * et sicut onus grave gravátæ sunt super me.

content.latin: 37:6 Putruérunt et corrúptæ sunt cicatríces meæ, * a fácie insipiéntiæ meæ.
content.english: 37:6 My sores are putrified and corrupted, * because of my foolishness.

segments.t: Putruérunt et corrúptæ sunt cicatríces meæ, * a fácie insipiéntiæ meæ.

content.latin: 37:7 Miser factus sum, et curvátus sum usque in finem: * tota die contristátus ingrediébar.
content.english: 37:7 I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: * I walked sorrowful all the day long.

segments.t: Miser factus sum, et curvátus sum usque in finem: * tota die contristátus ingrediébar.

content.latin: 37:8 Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: * et non est sánitas in carne mea.
content.english: 37:8 For my loins are filled with illusions; * and there is no health in my flesh.

segments.t: Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: * et non est sánitas in carne mea.

content.latin: 37:9 Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: * rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.
content.english: 37:9 I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: * I roared with the groaning of my heart.

segments.t: Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: * rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.

content.latin: 37:10 Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: * et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.
content.english: 37:10 Lord, all my desire is before thee, * and my groaning is not hidden from thee.

segments.t: Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: * et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.

content.latin: 37:11 Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: * et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
content.english: 37:11 My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, * and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.

segments.t: Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: * et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ne in ira tua corrípias me, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. O Lord, do not chastise me in thy wrath.

segments.t: Ant.
Ne in ira tua corrípias me, Dómine.

content.latin: Ant. Inténde in adiutórium meum, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
content.english: Ant. Attend unto my help, * O Lord, the God of my salvation.

segments.t: Ant.
Inténde in adiutórium meum, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
Psalmus 37(12-23)

content.latin: 37:12 Amíci mei, et próximi mei * advérsum me appropinquavérunt, et stetérunt.
content.english: 37:12 My friends and my neighbours * have drawn near, and stood against me.

segments.t: Amíci mei, et próximi mei * advérsum me appropinquavérunt, et stetérunt.

content.latin: 37:12 Et qui iuxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: * et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.
content.english: 37:12 And they that were near me stood afar off: * and they that sought my soul used violence.

segments.t: Et qui iuxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: * et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.

content.latin: 37:13 Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: * et dolos tota die meditabántur.
content.english: 37:13 And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, * and studied deceits all the day long.

segments.t: Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: * et dolos tota die meditabántur.

content.latin: 37:14 Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: * et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
content.english: 37:14 But I, as a deaf man, heard not: * and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

segments.t: Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: * et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.

content.latin: 37:15 Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: * et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
content.english: 37:15 And I became as a man that heareth not: * and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.

segments.t: Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: * et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.

content.latin: 37:16 Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: * tu exáudies me, Dómine, Deus meus.
content.english: 37:16 For in thee, O Lord, have I hoped: * thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.

segments.t: Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: * tu exáudies me, Dómine, Deus meus.

content.latin: 37:17 Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: * et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
content.english: 37:17 For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: * and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.

segments.t: Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: * et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.

content.latin: 37:18 Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: * et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
content.english: 37:18 For I am ready for scourges: * and my sorrow is continually before me.

segments.t: Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: * et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.

content.latin: 37:19 Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: * et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
content.english: 37:19 For I will declare my iniquity: * and I will think for my sin.

content.latin: Thomas, in óppido Fontispláni Toletánæ diœcéseos in Hispánia natus, a bonis paréntibus, ineúnte vita, pietátem et singulárem in páuperes misericórdiam accépit, cuius toto vitæ suæ decúrsu præclára dedit exémpla. Puer enim, ut nudos operíret, própriis véstibus non semel seípsum éxuit; adoléscens, post patris óbitum univérsam hereditátem egénis virgínibus aléndis dicávit. Cum, theologíæ cursu confécto, divíno instínctu, Eremitárum sancti Augustíni institútum ampléxus esset, virtútibus ómnibus ornátus, caritáte præsértim erga páuperes et peccatóres excélluit, quos e vitiórum cœno edúcere satégit. Præcípue vero eius misericórdia elúxit, cum, ad regéndam Valentínam ecclésiam ex obediéntia vocátus, vigilantíssimi pastóris vices explévit et amplos ecclésiæ réditus in egénos dispérsit, ne léctulo quidem sibi relícto. Obdormívit in Dómino, sexto idus septémbris, annos natus octo supra sexagínta.
content.english: Thomas was born of good parents in the town of Fuentellana in the diocese of Toledo, Spain. From his earliest years, he showed the greatest devotion and the singular kindness toward the poor of which his whole future life was to give such shining examples. For, as a boy, more than once he took off his own garments to clothe the naked; and as a young man, after his father's death, he gave his whole inheritance for the support of needy girls. When he had finished his course in theology, by a divine inspiration he embraced the Institute of the Hermits of St. Augustine. He was adorned with all virtues and excelled particularly in charity toward the poor and toward sinners, whom he strove to lead out of the mire of vice. His charity was most evident when, called by obedience to rule the church of Valencia, he carried out the duties of a most watchful shepherd and distributed the large revenues of the church to the needy, leaving himself not even a bed. He fell asleep in the Lord on the 8th day of September in his sixty-eighth year.

Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.

content.latin: Pleni sunt cæli et terra * maiestátis glóriæ tuæ.
content.english: Heaven and earth are full * of the Majesty of thy glory.

content.latin: Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus,
content.english: The glorious company of the Apostles * praise thee.

content.latin: Te Prophetárum * laudábilis númerus,
content.english: The goodly fellowship of the Prophets * praise thee.

content.latin: Te Mártyrum candidátus * laudat exércitus.
content.english: The noble army of Martyrs * praise thee.

content.latin: Te per orbem terrárum * sancta confitétur Ecclésia,
content.english: The holy Church throughout all the world * doth acknowledge thee;

content.latin: Patrem * imménsæ maiestátis;
content.english: The Father, * of an infinite Majesty.

content.latin: Venerándum tuum verum * et únicum Fílium;
content.english: Thine honourable, true, * and only Son;

content.latin: Sanctum quoque * Paráclitum Spíritum.
content.english: Also the Holy Ghost, * the Comforter.

content.latin: Tu Rex glóriæ, * Christe.
content.english: Thou art the King of Glory, * O Christ.

content.latin: Tu Patris * sempitérnus es Fílius.
content.english: Thou art the everlasting * Son of the Father.

content.latin: Fit reverentia Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.
content.english: During the following verse all make a profound bow: When thou tookest upon thee to deliver man, * thou didst not abhor the Virgin's womb.

segments.t: Fit reverentia
Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.

content.latin: Tu, devícto mortis acúleo, * aperuísti credéntibus regna cælórum.
content.english: When thou hadst overcome the sharpness of death, * thou didst open the Kingdom of Heaven to all believers.

content.latin: Tu ad déxteram Dei sedes, * in glória Patris.
content.english: Thou sittest at the right hand of God, * in the glory of the Father.

content.latin: Iudex créderis * esse ventúrus.
content.english: We believe that thou shalt come * to be our Judge.

content.latin: Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.
content.english: Kneel for the following verse We therefore pray thee, help thy servants, * whom thou hast redeemed with thy precious Blood.

segments.t: Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus
Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.

content.latin: Ætérna fac cum Sanctis tuis * in glória numerári.
content.english: Make them to be numbered with thy Saints, * in glory everlasting.

content.latin: Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, * et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.
content.english: O Lord, save thy people, * and bless thine heritage.

content.latin: Et rege eos, * et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
content.english: Govern them, * and lift them up for ever.

content.latin: Per síngulos dies * benedícimus te.
content.english: Day by day * we magnify thee;

content.latin: Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: During the following verse, by local custom, all make a profound bow. And we worship thy Name * ever, world without end.

segments.t: Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem
Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: Dignáre, Dómine, die isto * sine peccáto nos custodíre.
content.english: Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us * this day without sin.

content.latin: Miserére nostri, Dómine, * miserére nostri.
content.english: O Lord, have mercy upon us, * have mercy upon us.

content.latin: Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos, * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
content.english: O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us, * as our trust is in thee.

content.latin: In te, Dómine, sperávi: * non confúndar in ætérnum.
content.english: O Lord, in thee have I trusted, * let me never be confounded.

content.latin: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.
content.english: Skip the rest, unless praying separately.

segments.t: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui beátum Thomam Pontíficem insígnis in páuperes misericórdiæ virtúte decorásti: quǽsumus; ut, eius intercessióne, in omnes, qui te deprecántur, divítias misericórdiæ tuæ benígnus effúndas.
content.english: O God, Who didst adorn the blessed Bishop Thomas with the grace of an excellent pitifulness toward the needy, we entreat thee for the same thy servant's sake mercifully to pour forth the riches of thine own pitifulness upon all them which cry unto thee.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Cantáte * Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.
content.english: Ant. Sing ye * to the Lord and bless his name.

segments.t: Ant.
Cantáte * Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.

content.latin: Psalmus 95 [1]
content.english: Psalm 95 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 95

content.latin: 95:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.
content.english: 95:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * sing to the Lord, all the earth.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.

content.latin: 95:2 Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.
content.english: 95:2 Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: * shew forth his salvation from day to day.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.

content.latin: 95:3 Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.
content.english: 95:3 Declare his glory among the Gentiles: * his wonders among all people.

segments.t: Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.

content.latin: 95:4 Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.
content.english: 95:4 For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: * he is to be feared above all gods.

segments.t: Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.

content.latin: 95:5 Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.
content.english: 95:5 For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: * but the Lord made the heavens.

segments.t: Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.

content.latin: 95:6 Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.
content.english: 95:6 Praise and beauty are before him: * holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.

segments.t: Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.

content.latin: 95:7 Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.
content.english: 95:7 Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour: * bring to the Lord glory unto his name.

segments.t: Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.

content.latin: 95:8 Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
content.english: 95:8 Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

segments.t: Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.

content.latin: 95:9 Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.
content.english: 95:9 Let all the earth be moved at his presence. * Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned.

segments.t: Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.

content.latin: 95:10 Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.
content.english: 95:10 For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: * he will judge the people with justice.

segments.t: Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.

content.latin: 95:11 Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.
content.english: 95:11 Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof: * the fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful.

segments.t: Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.

content.latin: 95:12 Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
content.english: 95:12 Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

segments.t: Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.

content.latin: 95:13 Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.
content.english: 95:13 He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with his truth.

segments.t: Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Cantáte Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.
content.english: Ant. Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name.

segments.t: Ant.
Cantáte Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.

content.latin: Ant. Salutáre vultus mei, * Deus meus.
content.english: Ant. The salvation of my countenance * and my God.

segments.t: Ant.
Salutáre vultus mei, * Deus meus.

content.latin: Psalmus 42 [2]
content.english: Psalm 42 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 42

content.latin: 42:1 Iúdica me, Deus, et discérne causam meam de gente non sancta, * ab hómine iníquo, et dolóso érue me.
content.english: 42:1 Judge me, O God, and distinguish my cause from the nation that is not holy: * deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man.

segments.t: Iúdica me, Deus, et discérne causam meam de gente non sancta, * ab hómine iníquo, et dolóso érue me.

content.latin: 42:2 Quia tu es, Deus, fortitúdo mea: * quare me repulísti? et quare tristis incédo, dum afflígit me inimícus?
content.english: 42:2 For thou art God my strength: * why hast thou cast me off? and why do I go sorrowful whilst the enemy afflicteth me?

segments.t: Quia tu es, Deus, fortitúdo mea: * quare me repulísti? et quare tristis incédo, dum afflígit me inimícus?

content.latin: 42:3 Emítte lucem tuam et veritátem tuam: * ipsa me deduxérunt, et adduxérunt in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernácula tua.
content.english: 42:3 Send forth thy light and thy truth: * they have conducted me, and brought me unto thy holy hill, and into thy tabernacles.

segments.t: Emítte lucem tuam et veritátem tuam: * ipsa me deduxérunt, et adduxérunt in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernácula tua.

content.latin: 42:4 Et introíbo ad altáre Dei: * ad Deum, qui lætíficat iuventútem meam.
content.english: 42:4 And I will go in to the altar of God: * to God who giveth joy to my youth.

segments.t: Et introíbo ad altáre Dei: * ad Deum, qui lætíficat iuventútem meam.

content.latin: 42:5 Confitébor tibi in cíthara, Deus, Deus meus: * quare tristis es, ánima mea? et quare contúrbas me?
content.english: 42:5 To thee, O God my God, I will give praise upon the harp: * why art thou sad, O my soul? and why dost thou disquiet me?

segments.t: Confitébor tibi in cíthara, Deus, Deus meus: * quare tristis es, ánima mea? et quare contúrbas me?

content.latin: 42:6 Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
content.english: 42:6 Hope in God, for I will still give praise to him: * the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

segments.t: Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Salutáre vultus mei, Deus meus.
content.english: Ant. The salvation of my countenance and my God.

segments.t: Ant.
Salutáre vultus mei, Deus meus.

content.latin: Ant. Illúmina, Dómine, * vultum tuum super nos.
content.english: Ant. May the Lord shine the light * of his countenance upon us.

segments.t: Ant.
Illúmina, Dómine, * vultum tuum super nos.

content.latin: Psalmus 66 [3]
content.english: Psalm 66 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 66

content.latin: 66:2 Deus misereátur nostri, et benedícat nobis: * illúminet vultum suum super nos, et misereátur nostri.
content.english: 66:2 May God have mercy on us, and bless us: * may he cause the light of his countenance to shine upon us, and may he have mercy on us.

segments.t: Deus misereátur nostri, et benedícat nobis: * illúminet vultum suum super nos, et misereátur nostri.

content.latin: 66:3 Ut cognoscámus in terra viam tuam, * in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
content.english: 66:3 That we may know thy way upon earth: * thy salvation in all nations.

segments.t: Ut cognoscámus in terra viam tuam, * in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.

content.latin: 66:4 Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus: * confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes.
content.english: 66:4 Let people confess to thee, O God: * let all people give praise to thee.

segments.t: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus: * confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes.

content.latin: 66:5 Læténtur et exsúltent gentes: * quóniam iúdicas pópulos in æquitáte, et gentes in terra dírigis.
content.english: 66:5 Let the nations be glad and rejoice: * for thou judgest the people with justice, and directest the nations upon earth.

segments.t: Læténtur et exsúltent gentes: * quóniam iúdicas pópulos in æquitáte, et gentes in terra dírigis.

content.latin: 66:6 Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus, confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes: * terra dedit fructum suum.
content.english: 66:6 Let the people, O God, confess to thee: * let all the people give praise to thee: the earth hath yielded her fruit.

segments.t: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus, confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes: * terra dedit fructum suum.

content.latin: 66:7 Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, benedícat nos Deus: * et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.
content.english: 66:7 May God, our God bless us, may God bless us: * and all the ends of the earth fear him.

segments.t: Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, benedícat nos Deus: * et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Illúmina, Dómine, vultum tuum super nos.
content.english: Ant. May the Lord shine the light of his countenance upon us.

segments.t: Ant.
Illúmina, Dómine, vultum tuum super nos.

content.latin: Ant. Exaltáte * Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris.
content.english: Ant. Give ye glory to him * in your works.

segments.t: Ant.
Exaltáte * Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris.

content.latin: Canticum Tobiæ [4]
content.english: Canticle of Tobias [4]

segments.t: Canticum Tobiæ

content.latin: 13:1 Magnus es, Dómine, in ætérnum, * et in ómnia sǽcula regnum tuum:
content.english: 13:1 Thou art great, O Lord, for ever, * and thy kingdom is unto all ages:

segments.t: Magnus es, Dómine, in ætérnum, * et in ómnia sǽcula regnum tuum:

content.latin: 13:2 Quóniam tu flagéllas, et salvas: dedúcis ad ínferos, et redúcis: * et non est qui effúgiat manum tuam.
content.english: 13:2 For thou scourgest, and thou savest: thou leadest down to hell, and bringest up again: * and there is none that can escape thy hand.

segments.t: Quóniam tu flagéllas, et salvas: dedúcis ad ínferos, et redúcis: * et non est qui effúgiat manum tuam.

content.latin: 13:3 Confitémini Dómino, fílii Israël, * et in conspéctu géntium laudáte eum:
content.english: 13:3 Give glory to the Lord, ye children of Israel, * and praise him in the sight of the Gentiles:

segments.t: Confitémini Dómino, fílii Israël, * et in conspéctu géntium laudáte eum:

content.latin: 13:4 Quóniam ídeo dispérsit vos inter gentes, quæ ignórant eum, * ut vos enarrétis mirabília eius,
content.english: 13:4 Because he hath therefore scattered you among the Gentiles, who know not him, * that you may declare his wonderful works,

segments.t: Quóniam ídeo dispérsit vos inter gentes, quæ ignórant eum, * ut vos enarrétis mirabília eius,

content.latin: 13:5 Et faciátis scire eos, * quia non est álius Deus omnípotens præter eum.
content.english: 13:5 And make them know * that there is no other almighty God besides him.

segments.t: Et faciátis scire eos, * quia non est álius Deus omnípotens præter eum.

content.latin: 13:6 Ipse castigávit nos propter iniquitátes nostras: * et ipse salvábit nos propter misericórdiam suam.
content.english: 13:6 He hath chastised us for our iniquities: * and he will save us for his own mercy.

segments.t: Ipse castigávit nos propter iniquitátes nostras: * et ipse salvábit nos propter misericórdiam suam.

content.latin: 13:7 Aspícite ergo quæ fecit nobíscum, et cum timóre et tremóre confitémini illi: * Regémque sæculórum exaltáte in opéribus vestris.
content.english: 13:7 See then what he hath done with us, and with fear and trembling give ye glory to him: * and extol the eternal King of worlds in your works.

segments.t: Aspícite ergo quæ fecit nobíscum, et cum timóre et tremóre confitémini illi: * Regémque sæculórum exaltáte in opéribus vestris.

content.latin: 13:8 Ego autem in terra captivitátis meæ confitébor illi: * quóniam osténdit maiestátem suam in gentem peccatrícem.
content.english: 13:8 As for me, I will praise him in the land of my captivity: * because he hath shewn his majesty toward a sinful nation.

segments.t: Ego autem in terra captivitátis meæ confitébor illi: * quóniam osténdit maiestátem suam in gentem peccatrícem.

content.latin: 13:9 Convertímini ítaque, peccatóres, et fácite iustítiam coram Deo, * credéntes quod fáciat vobíscum misericórdiam suam:
content.english: 13:9 Be converted therefore, ye sinners, and do justice before God, * believing that he will shew his mercy to you.

segments.t: Convertímini ítaque, peccatóres, et fácite iustítiam coram Deo, * credéntes quod fáciat vobíscum misericórdiam suam:

content.english: 13:10 And I and my soul * will rejoice in him.

content.latin: 13:11 Benedícite Dóminum, omnes elécti eius: * ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.
content.english: 13:11 Bless ye the Lord, all his elect, * keep days of joy, and give glory to him.

segments.t: Benedícite Dóminum, omnes elécti eius: * ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.

content.latin: Psalmus 134 [5]
content.english: Psalm 134 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 134

content.latin: 134:1 Laudáte nomen Dómini, * laudáte, servi, Dóminum.
content.english: 134:1 Praise ye the name of the Lord: * O you his servants, praise the Lord:

segments.t: Laudáte nomen Dómini, * laudáte, servi, Dóminum.

content.latin: 134:2 Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.
content.english: 134:2 You that stand in the house of the Lord, * in the courts of the house of our God.

segments.t: Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.

content.latin: 134:3 Laudáte Dóminum, quia bonus Dóminus: * psállite nómini eius, quóniam suáve.
content.english: 134:3 Praise ye the Lord, for the Lord is good: * sing ye to his name, for it is sweet.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum, quia bonus Dóminus: * psállite nómini eius, quóniam suáve.

content.latin: 134:4 Quóniam Iacob elégit sibi Dóminus, * Israël in possessiónem sibi.
content.english: 134:4 For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself: * Israel for his own possession.

segments.t: Quóniam Iacob elégit sibi Dóminus, * Israël in possessiónem sibi.

content.latin: 134:5 Quia ego cognóvi quod magnus est Dóminus, * et Deus noster præ ómnibus diis.
content.english: 134:5 For I have known that the Lord is great, * and our God is above all gods.

segments.t: Quia ego cognóvi quod magnus est Dóminus, * et Deus noster præ ómnibus diis.

content.latin: 134:6 Ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, Dóminus fecit in cælo, et in terra, * in mari, et in ómnibus abýssis.
content.english: 134:6 Whatsoever the Lord pleased he hath done, in heaven, in earth, * in the sea, and in all the deeps.

segments.t: Ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, Dóminus fecit in cælo, et in terra, * in mari, et in ómnibus abýssis.

content.latin: 134:7 Edúcens nubes ab extrémo terræ: * fúlgura in plúviam fecit.
content.english: 134:7 He bringeth up clouds from the end of the earth: * he hath made lightnings for the rain.

segments.t: Edúcens nubes ab extrémo terræ: * fúlgura in plúviam fecit.

content.latin: 134:8 Qui prodúcit ventos de thesáuris suis: * qui percússit primogénita Ægýpti ab hómine usque ad pecus.
content.english: 134:8 He bringeth forth winds out of his stores: * He slew the firstborn of Egypt from man even unto beast.

segments.t: Qui prodúcit ventos de thesáuris suis: * qui percússit primogénita Ægýpti ab hómine usque ad pecus.

content.latin: 134:9 Et misit signa, et prodígia in médio tui, Ægýpte: * in Pharaónem, et in omnes servos eius.
content.english: 134:9 He sent forth signs and wonders in the midst of thee, O Egypt: * upon Pharao, and upon all his servants.

segments.t: Et misit signa, et prodígia in médio tui, Ægýpte: * in Pharaónem, et in omnes servos eius.

content.latin: 134:10 Qui percússit gentes multas: * et occídit reges fortes:
content.english: 134:10 He smote many nations, * and slew mighty kings:

segments.t: Qui percússit gentes multas: * et occídit reges fortes:

content.latin: 134:11 Sehon, regem Amorrhæórum, et Og, regem Basan, * et ómnia regna Chánaan.
content.english: 134:11 Sehon king of the Amorrhites, and Og king of Basan, * and all the kingdoms of Chanaan.

segments.t: Sehon, regem Amorrhæórum, et Og, regem Basan, * et ómnia regna Chánaan.

content.latin: 134:12 Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem, * hereditátem Israël, pópulo suo.
content.english: 134:12 And gave their land for an inheritance, * for an inheritance to his people Israel.

segments.t: Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem, * hereditátem Israël, pópulo suo.

content.latin: 134:13 Dómine, nomen tuum in ætérnum: * Dómine, memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
content.english: 134:13 Thy name, O Lord, is for ever: * thy memorial, O Lord, unto all generations.

segments.t: Dómine, nomen tuum in ætérnum: * Dómine, memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.

content.latin: 134:14 Quia iudicábit Dóminus pópulum suum: * et in servis suis deprecábitur.
content.english: 134:14 For the Lord will judge his people, * and will be entreated in favour of his servants.

segments.t: Quia iudicábit Dóminus pópulum suum: * et in servis suis deprecábitur.

content.latin: 134:15 Simulácra géntium argéntum, et aurum, * ópera mánuum hóminum.
content.english: 134:15 The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, * the works of men’s hands.

segments.t: Simulácra géntium argéntum, et aurum, * ópera mánuum hóminum.

content.latin: 134:16 Os habent, et non loquéntur: * óculos habent, et non vidébunt.
content.english: 134:16 They have a mouth, but they speak not: * they have eyes, but they see not.

segments.t: Os habent, et non loquéntur: * óculos habent, et non vidébunt.

content.latin: 134:17 Aures habent, et non áudient: * neque enim est spíritus in ore ipsórum.
content.english: 134:17 They have ears, but they hear not: * neither is there any breath in their mouths.

segments.t: Aures habent, et non áudient: * neque enim est spíritus in ore ipsórum.

content.latin: 134:18 Símiles illis fiant qui fáciunt ea: * et omnes qui confídunt in eis.
content.english: 134:18 Let them that make them be like to them: * and every one that trusteth in them.

segments.t: Símiles illis fiant qui fáciunt ea: * et omnes qui confídunt in eis.

content.latin: 134:19 Domus Israël, benedícite Dómino: * domus Aaron, benedícite Dómino.
content.english: 134:19 Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: * bless the Lord, O house of Aaron.

segments.t: Domus Israël, benedícite Dómino: * domus Aaron, benedícite Dómino.

content.latin: 134:20 Domus Levi, benedícite Dómino: * qui timétis Dóminum, benedícite Dómino.
content.english: 134:20 Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: * you that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Domus Levi, benedícite Dómino: * qui timétis Dóminum, benedícite Dómino.

content.latin: 134:21 Benedíctus Dóminus ex Sion, * qui hábitat in Ierúsalem.
content.english: 134:21 Blessed be the Lord out of Sion, * who dwelleth in Jerusalem.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus ex Sion, * qui hábitat in Ierúsalem.

content.english: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.english: Hymn

content.latin: Iesu Redémptor ómnium,
content.english: Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;

content.latin: Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
content.english: thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:

content.latin: In hac die cleméntius
content.english: Accept with gentlest love today

content.latin: Indúlgeas precántibus.
content.english: The prayers and praises that we pay.

content.latin: Tui sacri qua nóminis
content.english: The meek confessor of thy name

content.latin: Conféssor almus cláruit:
content.english: Today attained a glorious fame;

content.latin: Huius celébrat ánnua
content.english: Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,

content.latin: Devóta plebs solémnia.
content.english: Thy faithful people celebrate.

content.latin: Qui rite mundi gáudia
content.english: The world and all its boasted good,

content.latin: Huius cadúca réspuens,
content.english: As vain and passing, he eschewed;

content.latin: Æternitátis prǽmio
content.english: And therefore with angelic bands,

content.latin: Potítur inter Ángelos.
content.english: In endless joy forever stands.

content.latin: Huius benígnus ánnue
content.english: Grant then that we, most gracious God,

content.latin: Nobis sequi vestígia:
content.english: May follow in the steps he trod:

content.latin: Huius precátu, sérvulis
content.english: And, at his prayer, thy servants free

content.latin: Dimítte noxam críminis.
content.english: From stain of all iniquity.

content.latin: Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
content.english: To thee, O Christ, our loving King,

content.latin: Tibi, Patríque glória,
content.english: All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
content.english: All glory, as is ever meet,

content.latin: Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
content.english: To Father and to Paraclete.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.english: ℣. The Lord guided the just in right paths.

segments.t: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.

content.english: ℟. And showed him the kingdom of God.

content.latin: 1:68 Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
content.english: 1:68 Blessed be the Lord ✠ God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

segments.t: Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:

content.latin: 1:69 Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
content.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

segments.t: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.

content.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
content.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

segments.t: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:

content.latin: 1:71 Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
content.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

segments.t: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.

content.latin: 1:72 Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
content.english: 1:72 To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

segments.t: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.

content.latin: 1:73 Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
content.english: 1:73 The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

segments.t: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:

content.latin: 1:74 Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
content.english: 1:74 That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

segments.t: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.

content.latin: 1:75 In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
content.english: 1:75 In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

segments.t: In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.

content.latin: 1:76 Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
content.english: 1:76 And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

segments.t: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:

content.latin: 1:77 Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
content.english: 1:77 To give knowledge of salvation to his people, * unto the remission of their sins:

segments.t: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:

content.latin: 1:78 Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
content.english: 1:78 Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

segments.t: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:

content.latin: 1:79 Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
content.english: 1:79 To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

segments.t: Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.

content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui beátum Thomam Pontíficem insígnis in páuperes misericórdiæ virtúte decorásti: quǽsumus; ut, eius intercessióne, in omnes, qui te deprecántur, divítias misericórdiæ tuæ benígnus effúndas.
content.english: O God, Who didst adorn the blessed Bishop Thomas with the grace of an excellent pitifulness toward the needy, we entreat thee for the same thy servant's sake mercifully to pour forth the riches of thine own pitifulness upon all them which cry unto thee.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
content.english: Ant. Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

segments.t: Ant.
Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.

content.latin: ℣. Exsultábunt Sancti in glória.
content.english: ℣. The saints shall rejoice in glory:

segments.t: Exsultábunt Sancti in glória.

content.latin: ℟. Lætabúntur in cubílibus suis.
content.english: ℟. They shall be joyful in their beds.

segments.t: Lætabúntur in cubílibus suis.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Annue, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Maurítii et Sociórum eius nos lætíficet festíva solémnitas; ut, quorum suffrágiis nítimur, eórum natalíciis gloriémur.
content.english: Be merciful, almighty God, we beseech thee, that the solemn feast of thy martyrs, Mauritius and his Companions, may gladden us, so that we who rely on their patronage may joyfully celebrate the anniversary of their martyrdom.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,

content.english: Lowly of heart, our God we pray

content.english: That he from harm may keep us free

content.english: In all the deeds this day shall see.

content.english: May fear of him our tongues restrain,

content.english: Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:

content.english: His favouring care our guardian be,

content.english: Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

content.latin: Sint pura cordis íntima,
content.english: May every heart be pure from sin

content.latin: Absístat et vecórdia;
